name: AUETPPrescriptionIdentifier
title: AU ETP Prescription Identifier
description: This identifier profile defines an Electronic Transfer of Prescription (ETP) prescription identifier in an Australian context. An ETP prescription identifier is assigned to a prescription by an ETP vendor, e.g. ERx or Medisecure, and is the assigned numeric value of the barcode on a prescription instance.

element.short: Electronic Transfer of Prescription (ETP) Prescription Identifier
element.definition: Electronic Transfer of Prescription (ETP) prescription identifier assigned by an ETP vendor, e.g. ERx or Medisecure, to a prescription. This identifier is the assigned numeric value of the barcode on a prescription instance.

element.short: Coded identifier type for ETP prescription identifier
System identifier namespace for the ETP vendor that assigned the identifier
